organization_name.rationale: Organization legal name is a header field stored in the return header (ReturnHeader), not in IRS990EZ body elements; no matching candidate exists in the closed list.

doing_business_as.rationale: DBA name is a header-level element not present among the IRS990EZ body candidates.

ein.rationale: EIN is stored in the return header, not in the IRS990EZ body; no candidate matches.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax period begin date is a ReturnHeader element, not present in the IRS990EZ body candidate list.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax period end date is a ReturnHeader element, not present in the IRS990EZ body candidate list.

address_street.rationale: Organization principal office address is a ReturnHeader element; no IRS990EZ body candidate covers the organization's own street address.

address_city.rationale: Organization city is a ReturnHeader element; no matching body candidate exists.

address_state.rationale: Organization state abbreviation is a ReturnHeader element; no matching body candidate exists.

address_zip.rationale: Organization ZIP code is a ReturnHeader element; no matching body candidate exists.

address_foreign_country.rationale: Organization foreign country is a ReturnHeader element; no matching body candidate exists.

telephone_number.rationale: Organization telephone number in the header is a ReturnHeader element; the only PhoneNum candidates in the list are under BooksInCareOfDetail, which is a different context.

amended_return.rationale: AmendedReturnInd directly corresponds to the 'Amended return' checkbox in the header.

application_pending.rationale: ApplicationPendingInd directly corresponds to the 'Application pending' checkbox in the header.

group_return.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to a group return checkbox for the IRS990EZ body.

group_exemption_number.rationale: GroupExemptionNum directly maps to the Group Exemption Number field in the header.

organization_type.rationale: Organization type requires choosing among Organization501c3Ind, Organization501cInd, Organization4947a1NotPFInd, and Organization527Ind; the blueprint bundles these into one category field but the schema splits them into separate boolean indicators — blueprint should be refactored into multiple boolean fields or a derived value.

irc_section_other.rationale: @organization501cTypeTxt is the attribute that stores the specific 501(c) subsection number written on the form.

form_of_organization.rationale: Form of organization requires choosing among TypeOfOrganizationCorpInd, TypeOfOrganizationAssocInd, TypeOfOrganizationTrustInd, and TypeOfOrganizationOtherInd; the blueprint bundles them into one category but the schema splits into separate booleans — blueprint should be refactored into multiple boolean fields.

year_of_formation.rationale: Year of formation is not present among the closed candidate list for IRS990EZ body elements.

state_of_legal_domicile.rationale: State of legal domicile is not present among the closed candidate list for IRS990EZ body elements.

accounting_method.rationale: Accounting method requires choosing among MethodOfAccountingCashInd, MethodOfAccountingAccrualInd, and MethodOfAccountingOtherDesc; blueprint bundles into one category but schema splits into separate indicators — blueprint should be refactored into multiple boolean fields.

accounting_method_other.rationale: MethodOfAccountingOtherDesc captures the description when the 'Other' accounting method checkbox is checked.

website.rationale: WebsiteAddressTxt directly corresponds to the organization's website address field in the header.

membership_dues.rationale: MembershipDuesAmt maps to Part I Line 3, membership dues and assessments.

sale_of_assets_gain_loss.rationale: GainOrLossFromSaleOfAssetsAmt maps to Part I Line 5c, gain or (loss) from sale of assets other than inventory.

benefits_paid.rationale: BenefitsPaidToOrForMembersAmt maps to Part I Line 11, benefits paid to or for members.

salaries_compensation.rationale: SalariesOtherCompEmplBnftAmt maps to Part I Line 12, salaries, other compensation, and employee benefits.

total_expenses.rationale: TotalExpensesAmt maps to Part I Line 17, total expenses.

excess_or_deficit.rationale: ExcessOrDeficitForYearAmt maps to Part I Line 18, excess or (deficit) for the year.

primary_exempt_purpose.rationale: PrimaryExemptPurposeTxt maps to Part III's primary exempt purpose description field.

program_service_accomplishments.rationale: ProgramSrvcAccomplishmentGrp is the repeating group element containing program service accomplishment rows for lines 28–30; blueprint should map to the group rather than individual child elements.

other_program_services_description.rationale: DescriptionProgramSrvcAccomTxt within ProgramSrvcAccomplishmentGrp covers line 31 description text, though the schema reuses the same element for lines 28–31; no separate line-31-only element exists.

other_program_services_expenses.rationale: ProgramServiceExpensesAmt within ProgramSrvcAccomplishmentGrp covers line 31 expenses, though the same element is reused for lines 28–31 in repeating group rows.

total_program_service_expenses.rationale: TotalProgramServiceExpensesAmt maps to Part III Line 32, total program service expenses.

officers_directors_trustees.rationale: OfficerDirectorTrusteeEmplGrp is the repeating group element containing Part IV officer/director/trustee rows; blueprint should map to this group.

activities_not_previously_reported.rationale: ActivitiesNotPreviouslyRptInd maps to Part V Line 33, significant activities not previously reported.

changes_not_previously_reported.rationale: ChgMadeToOrgnzngDocNotRptInd maps to Part V Line 34, changes to organizing documents not previously reported.

unrelated_business_income.rationale: OrganizationHadUBIInd maps to Part V Line 35a, whether the organization had unrelated business gross income of $1,000 or more.

form_990t_filed.rationale: OrganizationFiled990TInd maps to Part V Line 35b, whether Form 990-T was filed.

subject_to_proxy_tax.rationale: SubjectToProxyTaxInd maps to Part V Line 36, subject to proxy tax requirements.

political_campaign_activities.rationale: PoliticalCampaignActyInd maps to Part V Line 37a, political campaign activities.

section_501h_election.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to a section 501(h) election indicator for the IRS990EZ body.

lobbying_activities.rationale: LobbyingActivitiesInd maps to Part V Line 38, lobbying activities.

loans_to_officers.rationale: MadeLoansToFromOfficersInd maps to Part V Line 38a, whether loans to/from officers were made.

loans_to_officers_balance.rationale: LoansToFromOfficersAmt maps to Part V Line 38b, outstanding balance of loans to officers.

initiated_termination.rationale: OrganizationDissolvedEtcInd maps to Part V Line 39, whether the organization initiated liquidation or termination.

states_filed.rationale: StatesWhereCopyOfReturnIsFldCd maps to Part V Line 40, states with which a copy of the return is filed.

held_assets_for_others.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part V Line 41 (held assets for another organization) in the IRS990EZ body.

prior_year_return_filed.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part V Line 42a (prior year return filed) in the IRS990EZ body.

state_filing_required.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part V Line 42b (state filing required) in the IRS990EZ body.

foreign_financial_accounts.rationale: ForeignFinancialAccountInd maps to Part V Line 45a, whether the organization had a foreign financial account.

foreign_account_country.rationale: ForeignFinancialAccountCntryCd maps to Part V Line 45a, the country of the foreign financial account.

fbar_filing_required.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part V Line 45b (FBAR filing required) in the IRS990EZ body.

prohibited_tax_shelter_transaction.rationale: ProhibitedTaxShelterTransInd maps to Part V Line 46, prohibited tax shelter transaction.

taxable_party_notification_received.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part V Line 47 (taxable party notification received) in the IRS990EZ body.

section_4958_tax_paid.rationale: No candidate in the closed list directly corresponds to Part V Line 48 (section 4958 excise tax paid) as a single boolean indicator.

quid_pro_quo_disclosure.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part V Line 50a/b (quid pro quo disclosure) in the IRS990EZ body.

conservation_easement.rationale: TrnsfrExmptNonChrtblRltdOrgInd most closely matches a transfer to exempt non-charitable organization question, though the blueprint description references conservation easement/Line 51.

excess_benefit_transactions.rationale: EngagedInExcessBenefitTransInd maps to Part VI Line 45a, excess benefit transactions with a disqualified person.

excess_benefit_transactions_prior.rationale: No candidate in the closed list corresponds to Part VI Line 45b (awareness of prior-year excess benefit transaction) in the IRS990EZ body.

501c3_lobbying.rationale: LobbyingActivitiesInd is the closest match for Part VI Line 46 lobbying activities for 501(c)(3) organizations, though it is already mapped to the general lobbying field; no separate 501(c)(3)-specific lobbying indicator exists.

501c3_school.rationale: SchoolOperatingInd maps to Part VI Line 47, whether the organization operates a school.

501c3_hospital.rationale: OperateHospitalInd maps to Part VI Line 48, whether the organization operates a hospital.

501c3_transaction_with_taxable_entity.rationale: TransactionWithControlEntInd maps to transactions with a controlled entity, corresponding to Part VI Line 49b.

501c3_transfer_to_exempt_noncharitable.rationale: TrnsfrExmptNonChrtblRltdOrgInd maps to Part VI Line 50, transfers to exempt non-charitable related organizations.
